_note: Sign codes: L = lambda-shaped sign (also its h-hook and crossed variants), c = L-shaped hook sign, C = plain stroke where it stands for c (same shape as i; distinguished only by position before h/k), i = plain stroke, j = stroke with top flag, N = two-legged pi sign, M = three-legged barred sign, U = u-shaped sign, T = theta sign, Q = inverted-T sign, Z = z/2-shaped sign with tail, J = looped x-like sign, X = x-shaped sign, + = cross, 5 = five with flat top bar (s), S = round S without top bar (z). M in TR2 is written with its first leg detached. Signs V, I and 4 are kept literally.
